business_problem: But the business needed more than visibility into what had happened. Teams needed more flexibility to explore data, identify patterns and support forward looking decisions.
solution_summary: SAF-Holland uses SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks to better understand customer ordering behavior, turning more than 100 million SAP records into actionable insights. By accelerating analytics by 5x, the company is helping teams make more proactive supply chain decisions while building a foundation for AI-powered operations into the future. SAF-Holland saw an opportunity to extend its SAP landscape with SAP Databricks rather than introduce another disconnected analytics platform. The company uses SAP Business Data Cloud and SAP Databricks together to create a unified environment where data could move seamlessly between systems. Teams can now share SAP data products directly into SAP Databricks, enrich datasets and return insights back into SAP environments where business users already work.

SAF-Holland uses SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks to better understand customer ordering behavior, turning more than 100 million SAP records into actionable insights.
By accelerating analytics by 5x, the company is helping teams make more proactive supply chain decisions while building a foundation for AI-powered operations into the future.
For years, SAF-Holland relied on reporting platforms that provided visibility into business operations and helped standardize decision making processes.
SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Datasphere became important building blocks in the company's reporting landscape, delivering transparency and consistency across the organization.
